# NORVO Outdoor Living

> NORVO Outdoor Living (Lavrek Solutions OÜ) is an Estonian company that sells and installs bioclimatic aluminium pergolas across Estonia. The pergolas have louvred roofs that rotate 0–100°, are rainproof when closed, and are designed for the Baltic climate. Website languages: Estonian (main) and English.

## Key facts

- Product: bioclimatic pergolas (Estonian: bioklimaatilised pergolad) with adjustable aluminium louvres, hidden drainage through gutters and posts.
- Frame: certified 6063-T6 anodised, powder-coated aluminium. Standard colour anthracite RAL 7016; brown and white as custom orders.
- Mounting: free-standing or wall-mounted to a house.
- Standard sizes: 300×300, 400×300, 600×300, 400×400, 600×400 cm; height 275 cm. Custom sizes available.
- Models:
  - N2 – manual louvre control, no electricity needed, 3 standard sizes.
  - N4 – motorised louvres, perimeter LED lighting, 5 standard sizes (most popular).
  - N7 – made-to-order ultra-premium model up to 400×800 cm, integrated louvre LED lighting, rain sensor, optional motorised insect screens and heaters.
- Accessories: ZIP screens (blinds), frameless and framed sliding glass doors, sliding louvre doors, fixed louvre doors.
- Service area: delivery and professional installation across Estonia.
- Full service: NORVO also renovates or adjusts the terrace so the pergola fits and does the electrical work (lighting, motors, accessories) – all work can be ordered from one place.
- Quotes: online 3D configurator at https://norvo.ee/konfiguraator/ – the quote is emailed to the customer as a PDF.
- Payment: instalments via ESTO (ESTO 3 in three parts with no fee, or hire purchase over 3–60 months).
- Contact: +372 5345 0781, info@norvo.ee
